statements.t: Additionally, our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any period in the future.
We will continue to evaluate possibilities for future cost reductions.

We intend to provide Refinity with limited funding through the end of 2026, subject to the oversight of the Strategic Review Committee, to allow Refinity additional time to pursue strategic alternatives, including a potential sale or interim third-party financing, and we intend to conclude our funding of Refinity by the end of 2026.

In November 2026, we sold all of the equity interests in Vital1 LLC (“Vital1”), then a wholly owned subsidiary, to a related party in exchange for a $2.0 million secured promissory note and the assumption of substantially all of Vital1’s liabilities, and we will no longer fund Vital1.
In presenting Adjusted EBITDA, we aim to provide investors with an additional tool for assessing the operational performance of our business.

The condensed consolidated financial statements have been prepared assuming that we will continue as a going concern and, accordingly, do not include any adjustments that might result from the outcome of this uncertainty.
As of September 30, 2026, and over the next 12 months, we anticipate that Innventure will require at least $25.0 million to meet its operating needs and debt service.

We expect our cost reductions, together with the cessation of our funding of AeroFlexx and Refinity, to be partially offset by increased legal, financial advisory and other professional fees, including fees related to the work of the Strategic Review Committee and legal matters, which include the putative securities class action described in Note 16 Commitments and Contingencies and our capital raising activities.

We expect to meet these needs through a combination of cash on hand, strategic alternatives, including the monetization of assets, sales of Common Stock under the At the Market Offering Agreement, dated October 6, 2026 (the “Sales Agreement”), with Lucid Capital Markets, LLC (“Lucid”) and additional financings that we may complete.

The amount of capital we are able or willing to raise under the Sales Agreement, if any, will depend on, among other things, the trading price and volume of our Common Stock and the conditions and limitations set forth in the Sales Agreement, and there can be no assurance as to the number of additional shares we will sell, or the proceeds we will receive, under the Sales Agreement.
The Sales Agreement does not increase the aggregate amount of capital we intend to raise.

We intend to use it selectively as capital needs arise, after considering our funding requirements, prevailing market conditions and the dilutive effect on our stockholders, and we do not intend to use it to raise capital for Accelsius at current trading prices or to sell the full $60.0 million of Common Stock available under it.

We concluded our funding of AeroFlexx in November 2026 and our funding of Refinity is expected to cease by the end of 2026, with interim funding subject to the oversight of the Strategic Review Committee.
We can make no assurances that required financings will be available for the amounts needed, or on terms commercially acceptable to us, if at all.

We remain confident in the underlying opportunity at Accelsius and believe the transformation underway at Innventure is an important step toward translating that opportunity into value for our shareholders.”
